capabilities.virtualWorkspaces: CodeBurn reads usage from this machine; a virtual workspace gets no workspace scope.
config.workspaceOnly: Open the dashboard scoped to this workspace's projects. Switch to all projects from the dashboard's scope menu or the editor title bar.
config.defaultPeriod: The period the dashboard opens on when it has no saved position.
config.refreshInterval: How often the status bar, the summary and the dashboard refresh. Only a focused window or a visible summary refreshes.
config.statusBar.costAndQuota: Today's spend and the most-used plan quota.
config.statusBar.workspace: This workspace's spend today, then everything.
config.statusBar.format: What the status bar item shows. `~` marks a figure that is partly estimated.
config.currency.pattern: A three-letter ISO 4217 code, such as EUR.
config.currency: Display currency, as a three-letter code. Setting it changes the CodeBurn CLI's own currency, which every CodeBurn app shares. Empty leaves it alone.
config.provider: Count only this provider in the status bar and summary, such as `claude` or `cursor`. `all` counts every provider.
config.quotaProviders: Plans whose quota CodeBurn checks. Each check asks that provider's own API with the login already on this machine. Remove one to stop asking it.
config.nodePath: A Node.js 22.13 or later to run the CodeBurn CLI with, when the editor's built-in Node is too old. Empty finds one automatically.
